Name: NPC Fish
Author: xyariaa
Description:
[center][img width=359]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49346/49346-1785048714-433551906.png[/img][/center]
[size=4]A decidedly strange phenomenon appeared in the valley. The waters all around are seeing the arrival of some new kinds of fish. And you can't help but feel like they look quite familiar.[/size]

[size=3]The hunt will start once you reach fishing level 2, and after you are able to find secret notes. Your fisherman friend will come to you with a trouble that will surely make you laugh! …But what if he was right?[/size]

[size=3]Scour the valley to find all these curious fish! Check every body of water, every trap, and even some weird and unusual locations can hold these creatures. And who knows, maybe you'll get a rewards…[/size]

[center][img width=309]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49346/49346-1785049336-1146681662.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*][size=3]Small introduction event and quest to delve into the mod.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]One catchable fish for each social NPCs, one crabpot fish for each non-social characters. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Only legendaries : you will catch one, and only one, of each fish, take care of them![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Placeable in ponds to reproduce! They colour the water with many different hues, and give interesting gifts for the related character.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Hint system through the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25055]Secret Note Framework[/url] (requirement) if you can't find them.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Reward for completing the collection![/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Available in [b]English[/b] and [b]French[/b] – please [b]contact me [/b]if you want to help translate in any other languages![/size][/*]
[/list][quote][size=3]/!\ Some fish have additional requirements for catching them. For fish that are part of an expansion and not catchable in a crabpot, if you can't find the note hinting at it, it probably means you can't catch it for now.[/size][/quote]
[center][size=3][img width=294]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49346/49346-1785049872-782067784.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=3]The classic valley isn't the only one who has the right to get curse with NPC Fish. We plan on adding as many Expansions and Standalones NPC as we can! Since we need permissions first, they will come little by little once we have the go.[/size]

[size=3][b][u]PLEASE NOTE[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]Support for mods that were not made to be compatible with each other was made while taking the incompatibilities into account. So if you have 2 incompatible mods touching the same NPC, [b]the fish will not show[/b].[/size]
